title: The Cheapest Ways to Watch Every NFL Game in 2026 - Yahoo Sports

facts.fact: The article states that a one-time antenna purchase gives access to local CBS, FOX, NBC, and ABC NFL games at zero recurring cost.
facts.quote: a **one-time antenna purchase** alone gets you local CBS, FOX, NBC, and ABC games at zero recurring cost

facts.fact: The article says a full live-TV bundle runs $70-plus per month, which it sets against the cost of an over-the-air antenna.
facts.quote: Stack that against a full live-TV bundle running **$70-plus per month**

facts.fact: The article states that NFL+ costs $49.99 per season, per the NFL's official support page.
The article lists Prime Video at $14.99 per month or $139 per year for Thursday Night Football, citing theyearlybill.com (a third-party source).
